description: This file defines the CustomerOrdersSpecification class, which is a specification for querying orders associated with a specific customer ID in the eShopOnWeb application. It uses the Ardalis Specification pattern to encapsulate query criteria for fetching customer orders along with their order items.

classes.name: CustomerOrdersSpecification
classes.description: A specification class for querying orders by customer ID, including order items.

methods.name: CustomerOrdersSpecification
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the specification with a buyer ID and sets up the query criteria.
